audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose is generic and never names what makes the lane hard: one 12s, 975-range Charm.
audit.why: Charm (E) is 12 seconds at every rank and out-ranges LeBlanc's Q (700) and W (600); it also instantly stops movement abilities, which means it cancels Distortion mid-dash and denies the return.
audit.corrected: Lane difficulty is set by Charm's 12s flat cooldown and 975 range; while it is up LeBlanc cannot use her W as an entry, only as an exit.

audit.why: Spikes are real: LeBlanc level 2 (Q sigil + W detonation), level 6 Mimic (45/35/25s), first item; Ahri spikes at 6 with Spirit Rush (140/120/100s, three dashes) and at full build where Orb's return true damage plus Void Staff ignores LeBlanc's low MR.
audit.corrected: Kept, with Spirit Rush's 100s rank-3 cooldown made explicit in breakdown.carry.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — Charm instantly stopping movement abilities, i.e. Distortion — was never stated, and breakdown.cooldowns contained no cooldown numbers at all.
audit.why: Riot's Charm text: 'instantly stopping movement abilities'. That is the whole matchup: it hits LeBlanc out of the W dash and off the return. Fox-Fire (9/8/7/6/5s) and Orb are projectiles; Charm is not blocked by the Mirror Image dealing no damage, but the clone gives a wrong body to aim at.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Charm 12s/975, Fox-Fire 9s-to-5s, Distortion 15s at rank 1, Mimic 45/35/25s.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Essence Theft sustain.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Essence Theft heals every 9 minions and more on a takedown, so poke-only patterns do not close the gap.
audit.corrected: Folded into breakdown.feeding with Oblivion Orb named.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mirror Image mechanics were never described despite a bullet titled around clone use.
audit.why: Passive: below 40% Health LeBlanc goes invisible 1s and spawns a Mirror Image lasting up to 8s.
audit.corrected: Stated in dontsFull[2].d with the real 40%/8s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[N] read LeBlanc x6 then Ahri — the page renders two answers to the same question.
audit.why: packet.levelChart and content win[] agree (LeBlanc 1-First item, Ahri 2+ items); the full layer is the outlier. phases[6].why also described LeBlanc winning the stage its own row loses.
audit.corrected: All seven sides aligned to the content layer as one atomic group, and phases[6].why rewritten to match the Ahri verdict.

edits.before: - Ahri Charm: matchup-defining — The charm starts every kill pattern — stay behind minions while it is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Distortion (return) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
